# A box of a file's substream that holds other bytes stops the chat's writes and says so, rather
# than being tried again for ever.

create alice g
join bob g
run
invite alice g bob
run
clobber-next alice WriteChunk
send-file alice g a.bin 5000
run
show alice g
----
— a new group: adding a member's voucher code adds them
— reading the voucher
— added ~bob: they now read everything said in this group
alice …: [file a.bin, 5 KB]
— a box of our stream holds something else: is this group used from another client?

state alice g
----
joined, 1 to write

pending alice
----
Wake
